programme.desc: In a Holocaust story of hope, 20,000 European Jews find refuge in Shanghai during WWII. Rivaling all elements and in tragic contrast to those who could not escape, it is a Holocaust story of life.

programme.title: Jewish Gis
programme.desc: Jewish GIs of WWII tells the profound and unique story of the 550,000 Jewish men and women who served in World War II. Held as POWs and awarded honours for merit and valour, thousands were wounded and 11,000 were killed in action. Ten thousand Jewish women joined up as well, disregarding their parents' warnings that the military 'was no life for a nice Jewish girl'. In the midst of it all, they fought a second, more private battle against anti-Semitism within the ranks. They endured slurs and even violence from their fellow servicemen, and often felt forced to prove their courage and patriotism. Jewish Americans earned their citizenship by shedding blood, leaving their outsider status behind.

programme.title: D-Day 360

programme.title: Jewish Gis
programme.desc: Jewish GIs of WWII tells the profound and unique story of the 550,000 Jewish men and women who served in World War II. Held as POWs and awarded honours for merit and valour, thousands were wounded and 11,000 were killed in action. Ten thousand Jewish women joined up as well, disregarding their parents' warnings that the military 'was no life for a nice Jewish girl'. In the midst of it all, they fought a second, more private battle against anti-Semitism within the ranks. They endured slurs and even violence from their fellow servicemen, and often felt forced to prove their courage and patriotism. Jewish Americans earned their citizenship by shedding blood, leaving their outsider status behind.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: On September 29, 1990, the body of twenty-two year old college student, Linda Yalem, is discovered off a bike path in a suburb of Buffalo, New York. Yalem has been raped and strangled with a garrote. DNA evidence recovered from her body allows police to link the crime to six other recent rapes in the Buffalo area. But other than DNA evidence police have little to go on; the murderer remains at large. Over the next sixteen years, attacks slow but do not stop. There is another rape and two more murders. Then advances in DNA technology and clues culled from unsolved rape cases lead police to the unlikely killer and rapist. He’s Buffalo suburbanite, Altemio Sanchez. Sanchez is a pillar of the community: married, with two children, and active in church and Little League.

programme.desc: One by one, prostitutes in Spokane, Washington are being hunted down and discarded in remote wooded areas by a vicious serial killer. On each victim’s head, police find his macabre calling card – a plastic bag emblazoned with an ironic Smiley Face. Investigators soon realize they are dealing with the worst type of serial killer – an Average Joe with no criminal background and with the extraordinary ability to blend in with the community. With few clues to work with – and as the death toll continues to rise – investigators turn to ballistics experts, space age fingerprinting technology, and to a Forensic Botanist who believes he can solve the crime by reading plants and trees.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: When the police in Farmington, New Mexico discover a broken window at a local head shop called The Eclectic, they expect to find evidence of a robbery. Instead they uncover a horrific crime scene, with two badly mutilated bodies. One year later, a battered body is found tossed into a canyon, the eyes and genitals gouged.Then the bloodied corpse of a naked woman is discovered on a remote road outside of town. As police search for clues to her death, tracking a lost cell phone, scattered footprints and layers of tire marks far into the desert, they soon come to a terrible realization - that one man and his friends are suspected in all three crimes. And when a renowned blood spatter expert finally determines who the murderer is, the community is shocked to learn that a serial killer has been living in their midst.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

What does she say was her role in the brutal slayings? And, Erin’s father, Terry, says he has forgiven his daughter -- will her revelations to Dr. Phil cause him to have a change of heart?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What would you do if you had a sneaking suspicion that your partner was unfaithful, but you couldn’t prove it? Elizabeth and Shawn say they’re at the breaking point in their marriage because Elizabeth thinks her husband is cheating on her. Shawn says he has nothing to hide, and the biggest issue in their relationship is Elizabeth’s lack of trust. Recently, Elizabeth received a phone call in the middle of the night from a man who accused Shawn of sleeping with his wife. How does Shawn respond? Then, the accused husband says he’s willing to take a polygraph test to prove his innocence. Find out what happens when Dr. Phil offers to provide the test backstage. Will Elizabeth’s fears be allayed, or does she have a reason to be skeptical of her spouse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Cheating, lying and sexual misconduct. Although public figures from John Edwards to Tiger Woods have admitted to this behavior, how would you handle accusations of infidelity in your own relationship? Tingle says she can’t trust her husband, Hermann. She says he lied about how many times he’d been married, and when she discovered he was registered on a singles dating site, he told her that he was doing research for a friend! She says she’s also suspicious of her spouse’s low sex drive and fears he may be getting his needs met elsewhere. Hermann says he wants to regain his wife’s trust but says he can’t handle her insecurity. Should Tingle give him another chance or kick him to the curb? And, when Elizabeth was last on the show, she wanted to know once and for all if her husband, Shawn, was being unfaithful. Find out why Shawn initially agreed to take a polygraph test but later declined. Can this relationship be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tony Fort was just 10 years old when he says a man his mother trusted to watch him began grooming him, brainwashing him, and sexually abusing him. Tony says he was vulnerable and lonely, and he believed the older man was his best friend. Tony claims the man gave him dangerous, addictive drugs, telling him it was candy, and videotaped Tony being sexually abused. The man even followed Tony’s family when they moved to a new state, and he eventually abducted Tony. Authorities say they believe he had a sinister and dark plan for the little boy. Today, Tony speaks out for the first time about what happened to him.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tony Fort, a young man who was abducted by a family friend when he was 11 years old, reunites two decades later with the FBI agent that he says saved his life. Go inside the dramatic rescue of Tony from a convicted sex offender. Plus, Alicia Kozak says she was just 13 when she was lured from her home by an internet predator and placed in a dog collar, chained to the floor, and horrifically abused. Hear her inspiring story of survival.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Jess, has wanted a dog for as long as she can remember, but living with her parents and renting has thrown up several ‘road blocks’. Jess wants a dog that her mum will cope with, and that will get along with her other passion….her horses.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Julien & Nicolette have three daughters, and Keira, 4, has an irrational fear of dogs. Dr. Lisa advises that the best thing to do might be to get a dog. Will the cure work and what special issues do three young girls put in her way?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: A big-hearted family needs Lisa's help to find them their first dog.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Bubbly single mum Edwina is looking for a dog to grow up with her two little girls, but she's torn when it comes to choosing between two adorable pooches.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Mitsy may appear to be normal but there is something terribly wrong. The rescue kitten is struggling to walk since being micro chipped and her foster family is worried that a misplaced chip may have caused spinal damage. Andrew Marchevsky is left with no other option but to operate. Will the surgery restore Mitzi's ability to walk or will she be made permanently worse?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is answering a call for help from May Dodd, who runs an animal shelter for abandoned donkeys. One of her residents, Dusty, has developed a very strange walk. May is worried if nothing can be done to help Dusty walk normally again, the donkey’s diminished quality of life that will be unbearable. Can Chris get to the bottom of this mysterious problem and save Dusty?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott tries to help a Spanish rescue cat with a chronic eye condition. A heartbroken young owner finds out the shocking news about her puppy, and can big hearts save two neglected canaries?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott and Emma fall in love with a fox that just can’t make it in the wild, Hugo the Bull Mastiff has just found a loving new home but his luck may have run out, and Scott has a testing time in the country with some exotic patients.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: There’s no time to rest as Chris is sent straight out to help a pregnant cow through a difficult labor. And his midwife duties are not over yet.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris’ country locum at the Kyabram Veterinary Clinic continues and some of his patients are a little out of the ordinary. Harriet the Bearded Dragon is a much loved resident of the local Fauna Park. Her Keeper Hannah is concerned about a lump that has suddenly appeared on the dragon's leg. The worry is that it could be cancer. Chris decides removing the lump is the only option, but on the operating table, things go horribly wrong. Can Chris save Harriet?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: At the Australian reptile park, Operations Manager Tim Faulkner is responding to an in-house emergency. Cameron the Cormorant has swallowed a mystery object, and it’s caused a dangerous swelling in the little bird's throat. Tim needs to remove the object urgently or Cameron may choke to death.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris faces a porker of a decision as he helps a young family choose a very unusual pet – a Mini Pig. A wrong decision could cause chaos, so Chris needs to make sure that the family is ready for the challenges of owning a little piggie.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: A five-month-old puppy needs emergency surgery after a freak accident and a baffling case for Scott as he tries to find out why a young poodle-cross is suddenly losing the use of her legs.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott has to deliver some devastating news to his sister-in-law Maz about her puppy Branston, a baby budgerigar needs help and a cat with a weird growth on it's head.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris's holiday in far north Queensland is interrupted as word of the visiting Vet has spread like wildfire. First stop is the Cairns Rainforest Station Nature Park where Chris has been asked to help a crook crocodile. A few months ago, Agro broke his jaw biting down on a steel fence. Chris needs to examine the injury, but everyone is on high alert for a very good reason. Not so long ago, Agro killed 9 other crocs that shared his pond. Is Chris biting off more than he can chew?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Ten-week-old Nala has been rushed to SASH with an extremely swollen face. It is so bad that she can barely see. The little Golden Retriever needs to stay in overnight for observation, but her protective owner isn’t willing to part with her baby. Will this new Mum follow doctor’s orders or take a risk with her sick puppy?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: In this episode, Scott deals with a liver disease scare for celebrity Dachshund Gigi; finds an astonishing cause of a lump in the stomach of a Maine Coon cat, and there’s a miracle recovery for the victim of a horrific car accident.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott is called to see why an elderly dog has suddenly collapsed; Jack the Springer Spaniel needs massive lumps removed from his shoulder; and a pet guinea pig with a bladder stone.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Romi faces multiple emergencies when Lucy the groodle crashes before and during surgery, and Andrew treats a seriously ill goat that could be infested with a life-threatening parasite.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew must make a life and death decision on a close friend’s pet cow. Rachel investigates why a friendly young Labrador has developed a worrying limp, but can she calm her terrified patient down enough to even treat him.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: Alex and Gerardo team up to save a greedy groodle that swallowed a tube of glue, Brooke battles a large bone stuck deep inside a dog’s throat and a tiny kitten is rushed in after a play session with the family dog goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: On this episode of Bondi Vet ER Luna has been rushed in to Alex with shocking injuries, Gerardo desperately tries to save a new born puppy, and a sock has gone missing and Ollie is facing serious trouble.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Little Gizmo was saved from death row by Denise from PAWS rescue. The little Shih Tzu is suffering chronic ear infections, and for the last three months since his rescue, Chris and Denise have tried unsuccessfully to treat the debilitating problem. Chris is now being forced to take extreme measures or Gizmo will never be able to find a new forever home.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A sudden problem with Jemima’s hind leg has put an abrupt stop to her full throttle lifestyle. The shorthaired pointer has shattered her cruciate ligament, and without surgery she will never be able to walk normally again. Can Andrew Marchevsky repair Jemima’s badly damaged leg?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott performs life saving surgery on a tiny pet hedgehog; naughty Colin swallows a dangerous bone; two elderly cats need urgent treatment; and a nail trim for a pet parrot.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott helps a young kitten who’s fallen from a high door; Toby has an embarrassing problem; Poppy is struggling with painful hips and Lenny needs urgent ear surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to Victoria in response to an SOS from a young volunteer at Safe Haven Horse rescue. 11 year old Tash has fallen in love with a surrendered appaloosa gelding, Charlie. Tash is worried about a huge lump growing on Charlie’s eye and she’s hoping Chris can save her much loved Charlie.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is at the Hunter Valley to check on one of the zoo’s oldest residents, Mal. The 30-year-old spider monkey has a huge lump growing inside his mouth that has started to bleed. Chris needs to examine the lump to determine if it’s an easily treatable infection or a life-threatening tumor. What’s the diagnosis for this much loved monkey?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott treats Bulldog sisters with the same shocking bladder problem; a working holiday in Wales sees Scott perform extraordinary surgery on a cow, and all the dogs vie for his attention at the local agricultural show.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott nurses a brave neglected rescue dog back to health and finds him a home; New vet Phoebe takes on surgery on her first day; A 100 year old couple start a new family.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Mini pig James’s obsessive digging has got him in serious trouble with the local authorities. If he doesn’t stop digging massive holes in the park, the council may ban him. Can Chris solve this porker of a problem?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: On this special episode… Chris travels to Thailand to work with a wildlife crusader. Edwin Wiek and his team care for hundreds of homeless animals, many of them victims of abuse. Urgent medical attention is needed for patients ranging from elephants to monkeys to a sunbear. Chris also witnesses what happens when Thailand’s desperate elephants run out of food and a place to live. It’s a touching and sometimes confronting journey.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Lisa faces a tough challenge trying to find the right dog for a teenager who's been wary of dogs all her life.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Dr Lisa searches for the right dog for a busy young family.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Dr. Lisa helps a young couple to find their very first dog.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Lisa meets big-hearted pet lovers who already have a cat and one rescue dog and are ready to take on a second dog.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Badger needs surgery for a massive chest lump that’s affecting his breathing; little Cookie has developed an alarming snort; the search to find the owners of a lost kitten; and Scott adopts chickens.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott performs knee surgery on a much loved Boston terrier, Dumpy Dylan goes on a weight loss program, some fiesta felines put Scott's new vet Phoebe to the test and Scott's own dog needs surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A medical mystery for Chris as he tries to diagnose what’s wrong with a beautiful five month old border collie. puppy. Even Sash specialist surgeon Andrew is forced to look overseas for answers to this rare and baffling case. Plus we meet the newest member of the Bondi Vet family….Lisa’s tiny son, Hudson. Does he get on with his four legged brothers? Watch and smile.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Another remarkable journey for Chris. This time he travels to the remote parts of northern Kenya to see the work of a brave Aussie zoo keeper fighting to save some of the world’s most endangered animals. In this extraordinary episode, Chris treats an orphaned baby rhino, takes cover from gunfire as an anti poaching squad hunts down a killer and saves the life of a badly mauled goat. Plus the Bondi Vet meets some amazing women and finds out how their beautiful beads are saving wildlife and gets involved with a crazy jumping competition with some Masai warriors.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Beloved pug Bafta may have a potentially fatal tumour; nervous border collie Shearer must overcome his fear of the vets and Scott takes a trip up North to help a Donkey Sanctuary whose owners were caught up in the Manchester bombings.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: A very sick pug needs emergency high risk surgery; hedgehog Luta returns to the practice with a worrying lump; Phoebe hits the streets of London to help care for the dogs of the homeless; Scott performs a complex operation to save Fifi's broken leg.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: There will be no shortage of dog sitters if Lisa can find the first dog for a family of seven, but it's going to be a challenge to get everyone to agree.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Cassandra and Andrea are ready for a pet, but neither of them has owned a dog before so they definitely need Dr Lisa's help.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: A couple of outdoor adventurers ready for another rescue dog ask for Dr Lisa's help to find them one that will suit their lifestyle.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Lisa extends some extra help to pet lovers who are looking to adopt a dog.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris Brown and Dr Lisa Chimes head out to the burnt regions of the Blue Mountains on the Sydney outskirts the day after some of the most intense bushfires on record. The mass evacuations of farms and properties have left animals injured, stranded or in distress. The Bondi Vet team take to the road to help where they can. The last thing Chris expected was to be treating a baby alpaca named Jersey. Jersey’s mother went into premature labour, brought on by the stressful evacuation of the herd from their fire threatened property. Now the new-born Cria (baby alpaca) is listless and deteriorating alarming.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In this episode of Bondi Vet, Georgie, a small rescue dog, is brought in to see Dr Chris Brown. Georgie has a massive growth on her leg and Chris discovers another lump that is possibly more sinister. she will need an immediate, marathon operation that Chris hopes the dog can survive.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: A health scare for Scott's nurse's new rescue dog from Romania; much loved English bulldog Daisy has a worrying head tremor and Scott is kept busy treating a hedgehog, a kestrel and a swan at a wildlife rescue centre.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott tries to save the damaged tail of a 14-week-old Cocker Spaniel pup; a high-tech eye operation on a much loved Staffy and a dramatic puppy birth puts Scott to the test.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is heading to the Halls Gap Zoo in Western Victoria where Stephanie the Lemur awaits. Recently the keepers have noticed her left canine tooth has darkened and are concerned it is an infection that could become a major problem for the small Lemur, especially as they suspect she may be pregnant.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris has received a call from Tim Faulkner at the Australian Reptile Park. One of the parks kangaroo’s has a nasty lump under its chin and Chris needs to make an emergency dash to the park to perform an urgent operation, that is made more difficult as the roo is a mother with young joey.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott undertakes a risky anaesthetic to save a 14 year old family dog; French bulldog pup Vince is suffering from a mystery disease and Scott checks up on pregnant pigs and rare breed rams at a working farm in the heart of London.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill

After a disastrous night serving a food critic, she receives an invitation to judge a food competition in honor of the prestigious annual fundraiser for the St. Andrew’s Children’s Hospital. Alice accepts the invitation despite the dismay of BRETT, her boss who is also her boyfriend. Once she gets to Kansas, Alice is surprised to find her former boyfriend in college, CHRISTIAN (Scot cooper), is amongst the judges. The cooking show and her reconnection with Christian will make Alice reconsider her calling and make her dreams come true.

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: We in This Together
programme.desc: Attorney August marries Daisha, a social climber more interested in his bank account than motherhood. To hide her infertility, Daisha secretly adopts 17-year-old "Lil August," sparking an immediate, violent rivalry. While August dismisses the teen’s lethal behavior as "playful," Daisha finds herself trapped in a house with a son who may be a killer. As she plots to conceive a biological heir, a series of dark secrets and "accidents" leave the family’s survival in question.

programme.title: Hoodie Girls Gang
programme.desc: Kayla's boyfriend Jamal is jailed and needs $10,000 bail. Desperate, Kayla and her friends plan an armed robbery. However, the heist goes wrong, and the police are on their trail. To make matters worse, Jamal's boss, Sean, demands payment for the drugs Jamal was transporting. Kayla must now free Jamal and escape town before both the police and Sean catch up to her.

programme.title: Double Standards 2
programme.desc: When Pastor Noble Jonez’s carefully constructed image begins to unravel, his wife Trezjiir is forced to confront not only the trauma of her past but the deceit poisoning her present. As buried secrets resurface—ranging from infidelity, hidden paternity, abuse of power, and criminal ties—every lie brings them closer to destruction.

programme.title: Room Available
programme.desc: When Emily rents a room from a seemingly kind landlord, she discovers his house hides deadly secrets — including past tenants, jealous lovers, and a dark obsession that may cost her life.

programme.title: Scarred
programme.desc: Nate meets and hooks up with the beautiful Mia after a night out. Everything is beautiful, until Nate’s wife Kamryn discovers his infidelity. The love triangle begins to spiral as everyone is on edge, and that some actions have deadly consequences.

programme.title: The Honeymoon
programme.desc: On her birthday, Summer is publicly humiliated when her fiancé, Chance, and her best friend, Portia, reveal their affair. Seeking revenge, she sabotages their honeymoon with the help of her friend Danisha. A deadly game of cat-and-mouse ensues, with betrayal, violence, and unexpected twists. Ultimately, Summer must confront the consequences of her actions as she fights for her life and seeks justice.

programme.title: Judge Knott
programme.desc: A father’s horrible mistake causes a lifetime of pain for his children. His son tries his best to live a normal life, but his childhood trauma follows him into his marriage. He must face his trauma head on to break this generational curse.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Kiss Me Once
programme.desc: Gabrielle, a delusional romantic, fixates on anyone who shows her the slightest interest. Her obsession turns dangerous when her feelings aren't reciprocated.

programme.title: Threaded Lies
programme.desc: When rising fashion designer Dante prepares to launch his brand, haunting messages and resurfaced betrayals from his former partner threaten to unravel everything. As paranoia sets in, Dante must confront the lies he’s built his success on before they destroy him.

programme.title: All the Love
programme.desc: A young woman begins her journey to adulthood, navigating love and self-discovery, while being haunted by a mysterious past that she can’t fully remember. As murders and violence swirl around her, she wonders who she can trust. Will she find love or suffer the same mysterious fate as her birth parents?

programme.title: Don Dada
programme.desc: Desperate to survive a brutal Chicago winter, Rah Jah and Tee Tee hustle for food and shelter in the streets. When a botched deal lands him in the hands of powerful crime bosses, he rises to the top of the hierarchy at a deadly cost.

programme.title: Apex
programme.desc: A special ops team enters the underground bunker "Hades" to rescue missing scientists, only to uncover a terrifying secret far beyond their expectations.

programme.title: CUT
programme.desc: Bunny is attempting to rebuild her life in Atlanta. Her financial aid suddenly falls through, until she meets Renee who shows her the ways of hustling and fast money, as well as Ed, a music producer and drug addict. Will her bad choices and mistake take her down the wrong path?

programme.title: What I'd Do For Love
programme.desc: Greer Patterson’s happy marriage falls apart when she discovers her husband’s infidelity. After exacting bitter revenge, she’s back on the market looking for love, and anyone standing in her way will see just how far she’ll go.

programme.title: Risk it All
programme.desc: Sierra, a gifted but overlooked painter, struggles to balance her artistic dreams with the reality of a stable life alongside her devoted but practical husband, Marcus. When a powerful and seductive art collector offers her the recognition she’s always craved, Sierra is drawn into a world where ambition blurs moral lines and desire turns dangerous. As passion, obsession, and betrayal collide, she must decide how much she’s truly willing to sacrifice to be seen.

programme.title: Fatal Promises
programme.desc: Haunted by unresolved trauma, Renae Morgan swears off love until Kingston Coleman, a charming and powerful attorney, pulls her back in. When his lies and betrayal begin to surface, Renae turns to Eric, a loyal longtime friend, and together their search for truth spirals into obsession, revenge, and deadly consequences.

programme.title: Don't Miss the Bus
programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: 3 Excavators Loading Overburden + Cat 160H Grader in Huge Mine
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we’re at the heart of a massive open-pit mining operation, where three powerful excavators and a Caterpillar 160H grader are working together with amazing precision and coordination to move overburden and prepare the site for the next phase of production.

programme.title: Relocating The Caterpillar D9T Dozer, Liebherr 974 & Liebherr 954
programme.desc: In today’s heavy haul video, we follow a full relocation operation, transporting three massive machines from one job site to the next nearby project using a heavy-duty trailer and a MAN TGX 530 special transport truck.

programme.title: Mining Site Full Of Caterpillar & Liebherr Excavators And Fleet Of Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s video, we are inside a busy coal mining site, watching a non-stop operation where multiple excavators load coal and overburden onto a fleet of 4-axle trucks.

programme.title: Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loader Loading Cat 777F Dumpers With Aggregates
programme.desc: In today’s video, we’re inside a huge aggregate quarry, watching an impressive, high-production operation where a Caterpillar 992K wheel loader loads blasted material onto Caterpillar 777F dumpers with speed, precision, and nonstop rhythm.

programme.title: Komatsu D475 Bulldozer With Engine Failure Hauled To Service
programme.desc: After suffering a major engine failure, the Komatsu D475 had to be transported immediately to the service unit. Time was critical and the transport team acted fast, loading this giant machine onto a heavy-duty trailer and making their way through the mine's rugged terrain.

programme.title: Loading & Transporting On Site The Huge Liebherr 984 Excavator
programme.desc: In today’s incredible ground footage, we follow the full behind-the-scenes process of preparing, loading, and transporting one of the largest excavators in the mine — the mighty Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator.

programme.title: Liebherr 974 Excavator & Cat 352F With Hydr. Hammer Loading Stone Layers In Bell B50D
programme.desc: The Liebherr 974 hydraulic excavator, a true beast of the quarry world, is loading Bell B50D articulated dump trucks with material that has first been broken up by the Caterpillar 352F excavator, equipped with a Montabert hydraulic breaker. The breaker works relentlessly to fracture tough rock formations, allowing the 974 to load fast and efficiently.

programme.title: Cat 385C, Terex RH30F & Liebherr 954 Excavators Breaking & Loading Stones
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, watching a powerful lineup of three heavy-duty excavators working in perfect coordination to break and load extremely hard stone layers. - Leading the operation is the Caterpillar 385C excavator, equipped with a heavy bucket, responsible for loading broken debris onto Caterpillar dumpers. Supporting this are the: - Terex RH30F fitted with a vibro ripper, used to tear through tough rock layers - Liebherr 954 outfitted with a hydraulic breaker, smashing dense stone into manageable pieces - This combo of ripping, hammering, and loading shows how professional operators and the right equipment can handle even the hardest terrain.

programme.title: Giant Cat 5090B Front Shovel Excavator Loading Gravel On Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s stunning ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, capturing the raw power and precision of the Caterpillar 5090B Front Shovel Excavator. This giant machine is seen loading gravel from a deposit area onto a fleet of 4-axle Mercedes and MAN trucks, preparing materials for ongoing operations across the mine.

programme.title: Liebherr 984 Excavator Loading Caterpillar 777 Dumpers Drone View
programme.desc: At the heart of today’s footage is the giant Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator, operating at full production. From the air, the true scale of this machine becomes clear as it loads blasted material with smooth, powerful cycles.

programme.title: Brand New Cat 395 Excavator Loading Cat 777 Dumpers | Massive Earthworks
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we’re on a huge construction site where preparations are underway for the development of a massive industrial factory. At the center of this large-scale earthmoving operation is the brand new Caterpillar 395 hydraulic excavator, performing with incredible speed and precision. - The 395 is seen loading Caterpillar 777 rigid dump trucks with heavy material, clearing the area and shaping the land for the upcoming construction phases. With a skilled operator at the controls, the machine delivers fast, efficient loading cycles—keeping the trucks moving and the site on schedule. - This footage is a showcase of modern heavy equipment working in perfect sync to execute a high-volume project with power and productivity.

programme.title: Caterpillar 365C & Caterpillar 385C Excavators Loading Coal on 4 Axle Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s powerful ground footage, we’re deep inside a massive coal mining operation, watching two legendary machines—the Caterpillar 365C and Caterpillar 385C hydraulic excavators—working side by side to load coal onto 4-axle Mercedes and MAN trucks. - These machines, operated by highly skilled professionals, deliver fast and accurate loading cycles, keeping up with the demands of a non-stop production environment. The teamwork between the two excavators and the constant flow of dump trucks showcases perfect coordination, machine power, and mining efficiency at its finest.

programme.title: Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loader Loading Caterpillar 777F Dumpers In Huge Quarry
programme.desc: In today’s stunning ground footage, we’re inside a massive aggregate quarry, witnessing the unmatched performance of the Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loader loading Caterpillar 777F dump trucks with blasted materials. - This footage captures not just the raw power of the machines, but also the refined skill of the operator, the tight coordination between the loader and the dumpers, and the efficient production cycles that keep the quarry running at full speed. - Every bucket is on point. Every pass is fast. This is how top-tier aggregate operations maintain productivity, consistency, and precision—day in, day out.

programme.title: DRONE FOOTAGE! Caterpillar D9T Bulldozer Rehabilitating an Old Mine
programme.desc: Welcome back to the Mega Machines channel, where the world’s most powerful machines reshape massive landscapes. In today’s stunning 4K drone video, we fly above a huge old mining site, capturing cinematic aerial footage of a Caterpillar D9T bulldozer working nonstop to rehabilitate and restore the former mine area. - This is heavy equipment power seen from the sky.

programme.title: Caterpillar 365B, 352F & Liebherr 964 Loading Fleet Of Trucks At Massive Mine

programme.desc: The North Shore is a 7 Mile stretch of paradise like no other on Earth. Every year thousands of people flock to the North Shore of Oahu to see the world's best surfers ride arguably the world's best waves. Pro surfers have created their careers, made their livings and even become legends from surfing these shores. Pro surfer Anastasia Ashley will be your tour guide and take you to the places she loves, the places she went as a kid growing up there, and introduce you to the people that always made it feel like home. We will experience and understand why she loves the North Shore, and considers it '7 Miles of Paradise'

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Superpitufo
programme.desc: Gigantón roba el suministro de alimentos de invierno y de los Pitufos y Pitufo Filósofo prepara una de las pociones de fortaleza de Papá Pitufo para que pueda luchar contra el codicioso gigante. La súper fórmula desaparece, pero Papá Pitufo hace un cambio rápido, cambia la comida por piedras y Gigantón sale perdiendo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La malvada bruja se transforma en Pitufo para vengarse de ellos por destruir su amuleto mágico.

programme.title: El Bebé Pitufo
programme.desc: Gargamel se transforma en un Bebé Pitufo, para ser adoptado por los Pitufos. Causa un completo caos en la Aldea de los Pitufos cuando intenta hacerlos volar por los aires con una bomba. Papá Pitufo descubre su malvado plan y utiliza el explosivo para enviar al mago de vuelta a su deprimente castillo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las provisiones de comida de los Pitufos para el invierno se estropea y preparan un viaje hasta un lejano castillo en el que pueden refugiarse. Al principio, creen que el castillo está embrujado, pero tras descubrir que sólo se trata de un grupo de ratas, el propietario del castillo les obsequia comida en abundancia para el largo invierno.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Morados
programme.desc: La mosca morada muerde a Pitufo Perezoso, provocando una epidemia en el pueblo que convertirá a todos en furiosos Pitufos morados. Papá Pitufo descubre que el polen de una flor del bosque es el antídoto y pronto las cosas volverán a pitufar como siempre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Filósofo crea una poción que hace que Fortachón crezca de tamaño humano.

programme.title: Ahora Los Pitufeas Y Ahora No
programme.desc: Los troles subterráneos capturan a los Pitufos para que sean sus esclavos. Papá Pitufo ingeniosamente los libera y luego destruye la bola de cristal mágica que les concede el poder sobre los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Para tratar de descubrir dónde se encuentra el escondite secreto de diamantes de los Pitufos, Gargamel finge ser su amigo. Cuando muestra su verdadera naturaleza malvada, Papá Pitufo conjura un hechizo mágico para salvar a sus pequeños Pitufos de las garras maliciosas del mago malvado.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Perezoso sueña que está en la Isla Paraíso y libre de todo el trabajo que Papá Pitufo le impone. Su fantasía se vuelve una pesadilla que lo hace volver a trabajar nuevamente con afán.

programme.title: La Abominable Bestia De La Nieve
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y sus amigos organizan una jornada en la Montaña de Hielo para buscar la rara flor de la nieve para Papá Pitufo. Encuentran una terrorífica bestia de la nieve, pero acaban siendo amigos gracias a la amabilidad de Pitufina, y les ayuda a encontrar la minúscula flor.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina ha encontrado a una nueva amiga, Laura, una niña de seis años de edad cuyos padres viven cerca del bosque. Juntas, las dos niñas se pasean por el bosque. Pero una vieja bruja que vive en el bosque las captura.

programme.title: Educando A Goloso
programme.desc: Pitufo Goloso se excede. Se pone cada vez más pesado hasta que su peso lo pone en peligro. El malvado Gargamel va a atraparlo... ¿Pitufo Goloso podrá ser salvado por Papá Pitufo?

programme.title: El Dia Del Amor
programme.desc: Ha llegado el Día de San Valentín. La bruja Hogata se encuentra junto al estanque recogiendo plantas cuando, por accidente, una de las flechas de Cupido impacta en ella. Ahora, se enamorará perdidamente del primer hombre que se cruce en su camino… y, contra todo pronóstico, ese hombre es el mismo Gargamel. ¿Conseguirá que ella atrape a todos los Pitufos de un plumazo? ¿Y conseguirá Hogata librarse del hechizo de amor?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La vida en la Aldea Pitufa podría ser más tranquila si Puppy se comportara un poco mejor. Sin embargo, el pequeño perro de los Pitufos se dedica a escarbar entre las flores de Pitufina, ensuciar el nuevo papel pintado de Pitufo Vanidoso y arruinar los experimentos de Papá Pitufo. Aun así, Puppy va a ayudar a los Pitufos a escapar de una trampa que les ha tendido Gargamel. O quizá no tenga la disciplina necesaria para ello…

programme.title: El Pitufo Galante
programme.desc: La reina Agripina no dejará que su hijo, el príncipe Godofredo, se case con la dulce Priscila. Ella quiere como nuera a una chica que sea capaz de mostrarle algo que nunca antes haya visto. Cuando Hogata se entera y descubre la existencia de Abuelo Pitufo, está segura de que logrará sorprender a la reina con su captura. Por supuesto, Hogata debe atrapar primero a Abuelo Pitufo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está harto. Los Pitufitos y Sasita siguen inventándose historias sobre él con desagradables consecuencias. Por eso, prepara una fórmula mágica, extraída del libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo, que hace que los pequeños Pitufos crezcan y crezcan cada vez que dicen mentiras. Pero no había contado con que ahora Gargamel tiene una forma de capturar a los Pitufitos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una emergencia, todos los Pitufos de la aldea dejan lo que tienen entre manos y corren a oír las noticias. Pero que Pitufo Vanidoso convoque una asamblea para que los Pitufos puedan admirar su nuevo gorro es pasarse de la raya. Le echan de la aldea y Pitufo Vanidoso tiene la mala suerte de encontrarse con Lofty, el elfo, que le recomienda darse un horrible baño de fango…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué es esa extraña rana parlante que ha hecho que el hechicero Morlock haya enviado a todos los soldados del príncipe Teodoro para capturarla? ¿Es una rana demonio, como él dice? ¿O quizá lo hace por otro motivo? La verdad se desvelará cuando Pitufina y los Pitufitos se encuentran con la rana. Ayudan a la rana a volver a transformarse en el príncipe Teodoro, que había sido víctima de un hechizo lanzado por Morlock.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada 500 años, el Castillo Prisión aparece y secuestra a inocentes viajeros. Abuelo Pitufo despega en su globo hacia el castillo, donde se encuentra con Nana Pitufa, que lleva desaparecida 500 años. Tienen poco tiempo para escapar; de lo contrario, ¡se convertirán en invitados permanentes!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Fortachón, Pitufo Carpintero y Pitufo Filósofo pierden el telescopio de Papá Pitufo y Scour, el señor de los objetos perdidos, lo encuentra. Los Pitufos le dicen que darían cualquier cosa por recuperarlo, y Scour se apropia así de sus posesiones más preciadas: su fortaleza, su habilidad y su inteligencia. Entonces, viajan hasta sus dominios para recuperar lo que han perdido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Némesis aparece en la Biblioteca de los Magos para robar el conocimiento de los Archivos del Mal y hacerse con la Piedra de la Longevidad. Pero Pitufo Filósofo salva la situación sin darse cuenta, ya que cambia el libro de cocina de Pitufo Goloso por el libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina y Nana Pitufa comparten casa y se sacan de quicio la una a la otra, así que ha llegado el momento de que Nana Pitufa tenga su propia casa. Mientras Nana Pitufa y Pitufina salen en busca de una planta calienta hogares, los demás diseñan la casa más pitufantástica posible para ella.

programme.title: No Puedo Pitufar La Música
programme.desc: No hay nada que la hechicera Clorhidris odie tanto como el amor en el mundo. Le gustaría que el amor desapareciera de la faz de la tierra y, para conseguirlo, ha decidido comenzar por la música. Lanza un hechizo a un cuerno mágico que absorberá la melodía de las canciones… en especial, de las canciones de los Pitufos. Con la ayuda de su amiga Laconia, es posible que los Pitufos consigan echar por tierra el malvado plan de Clorhidris…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido unos huevos mágicos de cristal citoplásmico que le permitirán intercambiar su cuerpo con el de Papá Pitufo. ¿Qué otro plan mejor que ese podría haber? Una vez que esté en el cuerpo de Papá Pitufo, llevará a todos los Pitufos hasta su caldero. Pero, por juegos del destino, Gargamel se transforma en Perro, el perro de los Pitufos…

programme.title: El Genio De Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta qué hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando debería estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hará que, más que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: No todos los días se encuentra uno con una flor parlante. Y, en especial, con un personaje como Petaluma, una planta bulbosa algo arrogante con la que Pitufina se encuentra en el bosque. Por supuesto, Pitufina se muestra encantada y lleva a Petaluma con ella a la Aldea Pitufa… desencadenando un proceso que pondrá en peligro a todos los Pitufos. Parece que las flores están hechas para contemplarlas y no para escucharlas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos pueden cometer errores. Incluso Papá Pitufo. Su nuevo pulverizador para potenciar el perfume hace que una rosa huela como un millar de ellas… pero, debido a una serie de desafortunados sucesos, también hace llorar a todos los Pitufos, que se deshacen en lágrimas a la mínima. Mientras sollozan, berrean, se lamentan, gimen y lloriquean, el malvado mago Gargamel pasa a la acción…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Esta noche es el espectáculo de talentos en la Aldea Pitufa. Papá Pitufo va a hacer trucos de magia, Sasita actuará con su sapo mascota amaestrado, Pitufo Torpe intentará hacer malabarismos… y Pitufo Bromista ha hecho un muñeco de Gargamel y está seguro de que hará temblar de miedo a los Pitufos. Sin embargo, el auténtico Gargamel encuentra una forma de dar vida al muñeco de Pitufo Bromista, y entonces…

programme.title: Sorpresa Para Sassette
programme.desc: A veces, los pequeños actos pueden tener grandes consecuencias. Mientras intentaba atrapar a Sasita, Gargamel altera la Balanza de la Verdad y, desde ese momento, todos los habitantes del mundo comienzan a mentir. Incluso Papá Pitufo se ha convertido en un mentiroso compulsivo. Y, por si eso fuera poco, el espíritu de la balanza ha encadenado juntos a Gargamel y Sasita, que deberán volver a colocar en su sitio el Topacio de la Verdad…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Bebé Pitufo ha perdido el interés por los juguetes. Ni siquiera las sorpresas de Pitufo Bromista consiguen entretener al pequeño. Abuelo Pitufo propone hacer una visita al Juguetero, el encargado de fabricar juguetes para los niños de todo el mundo. O más bien, el que los fabricaba: el Juguetero está cansado del poco aprecio que demuestran por sus juguetes aquellos que los reciben.

programme.title: La Pitufivisión De Genio
programme.desc: Pitufo Minero rebusca bajo todas las piedras y, gracias a ello, descubre un cristal que transmite imágenes. Esto permite a Pitufo Carpintero inventar la pitufivisión y, desde ese momento, los Pitufos pueden ver todas las mañanas los entrenamientos de Pitufo Fortachón, los informes de las cosechas de Pitufo Labrador e incluso el programa de Pitufo Filósofo. Pero ¿quién podría haberlo imaginado? ¡El malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la pitufivisión para atrapar Pitufos!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo ha sido elegido Hechicero del Año, y el malvado mago Gargamel está verde de envidia. Buscará la forma de hacer que los poderes de Papá Pitufo desaparezcan. Entonces, podrá atrapar a todos los Pitufos y celebrarlo con un gran banquete… Ahora bien, ¿permitirá Papá Pitufo que suceda algo tan terrible? Por supuesto que no: Papá Pitufo encontrará la forma de arruinar el plan de Gargamel…

programme.title: El Color Mas Pitufoso
programme.desc: Spectra es el hada de los colores, y con su rueda de los colores crea todos los azules, rojos, amarillos y verdes del mundo. Es amiga de Pitufo Pintor, pero, cuando este lleva a los Pitufitos a su morada en su ausencia, los Pitufitos se ponen a jugar con la rueda de los colores… y provocan que todos los colores desaparezcan de la Tierra. Y, lo que es aún peor: sin colores, el hada de los colores no puede vivir…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Deshollinador se encarga de limpiar las chimeneas y no es precisamente el habitante más popular de la Aldea Pitufa. Es bastante desaliñado, y las nubes de hollín que suelta no contribuyen a aumentar su popularidad. Únicamente los Pitufitos le consideran una excelente compañía, ya que es el único Pitufo que puede ensuciarse sin que le riñan. Sin embargo, el entusiasmo de los Pitufitos por Pitufo Deshollinador pone en peligro la aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Genio inventa una máquina que hará todo el trabajo de cosechar y preparar la comido de los Pitufos. Pero esta milagrosa invención tiene sus bemoles.

programme.title: Pitufos Helados
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado y los Pitufos están a punto de sucumbir al intenso frío. ¿Podrá Pitufo Rastreador encontrar el remedio sin caer en las garras de Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una aventura dramática y conmovedora… Pitufina y su mascota Re chillido. La pequeña Pitufina está inundada en lágrimas. ¿Podrán los demás pitufos consolarla?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Soñador desea encontrar vida extraterrestre pero en la Aldea se burlan de él. Nadie le creerá cuando les diga que ha hablado con un ser de otro planeta.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha salvado a Pitufo Torpe de un terrible destino. Pitufo Torpe jura devoción eterna a su salvador y se esfuerza al máximo por saldar su deuda… con consecuencias desastrosas. Se hace necesario idear un plan ingenioso para evitar las bienintencionadas catástrofes causadas por Pitufo Torpe…

programme.title: La Venganza De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Se ha desatado una guerra en la Edad Media. Unos caballeros vestidos con armadura destrozan por accidente la Aldea Pitufa, lo que provoca que una pequeña banda de Pitufos decida vengar esta afrenta. ¿No pensará Papá Pitufo que esta es una acción demasiado propia de los humanos?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo y diabólico plan para librarse de los Pitufos: un polvo brillante que hará que no puedan dejar de reírse…

programme.title: Los Pitufos En El Laberinto
programme.desc: Pitufo Bromista está deseando conocer a Melchor el Magnífico, creador del famoso truco máximo de la desaparición. ¿Conseguirá atrapar Gargamel a los Pitufos en el laberinto fantástico de Melchor?

programme.title: Pitufo Dormilón
programme.desc: El Pitufo Perezoso se está volviendo demasiado dormilón. Los otros Pitufos han decidido gastarle una broma: cuando se despierte, se encontrará rodeado de Pitufos viejos y llenos de arrugas, y le dirán que ha estado dormido durante siglos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Miedoso entra corriendo en la aldea y grita que el cielo se está cayendo. Justo en ese mismo momento, Papá Pitufo está aquejado de un incontrolable ataque de estornudos…

programme.title: El Pitufo Sospechoso
programme.desc: ¿Puedes creer que Pitufo Filósofo condujo al malvado Gargamel hasta la Aldea Pitufa? Por supuesto, él no lo hizo. Sin embargo, los demás sospechan de él…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¡Pitufo Torpe ha desenterrado una extraña piedra! En ella, puede ver los eventos que van a suceder… ¡No obstante, conocer parte del futuro a veces trae mala suerte!

programme.title: Corazón De Oro
programme.desc: No importa lo que diga Pitufo Filósofo: Pitufo Robotín, la creación de Pitufo Carpintero, tiene sentimientos como cualquier Pitufo normal. O al menos eso parece… hasta que Pitufo Robotín pierde aquello que Pitufo Carpintero había colocado en su caja torácica: un corazón de oro. El malvado mago Gargamel y su aprendiz Escrupuloso encuentran al pequeño autómata y le colocan un corazón de piedra, lo que augura malos tiempos para los Pitufos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Para demostrar lo válido que es su «Gran libro de supervivencia en la naturaleza», Pitufo Filósofo se lleva a los Pitufitos al pantano. Allí, gracias a su experto consejo, el pequeño grupo se extravía, queda atrapado en arenas movedizas y es capturado por el Rey Verrugoso. Afortunadamente, el Rey Verrugoso está con ganas de jugar y decide hacer una caza del Pitufo. Desafortunadamente, Pitufo Filósofo cree que es un líder por naturaleza…

programme.title: Peligro En La Aldea
programme.desc: El pérfido mago Gargamel está harto de la constante superioridad de los Pitufos. Decide destruir su aldea de una vez por todas. Con ese fin, entrena una termita para que destroce, demuela, devaste y destruya todas las casas que se encuentre en su camino. Sin embargo, los efectos son mucho peores de lo que Gargamel había imaginado, ya que los Pitufos creen que las travesuras de los Pitufitos son las que están destruyendo su aldea.

programme.title: El Amo Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador es el reticente amo de un genio llamado Gourdy, cuyo entusiasmo por ser servicial es quizá algo excesivo. Tras un nuevo incidente provocado por el exceso de celo de Gourdy, Pitufo Labrador le dice algo que no debería haber dicho y Gourdy desaparece. ¿Y a que no adivinas quién lo encuentra? En efecto: Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. ¿Y quién podría arrebatar a Gourdy de las manos de Escrupuloso, sino el propio Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un duende maligno le pone unos zapatos mágicos a Pitufina, que no puede dejar de bailar, con la intención de que le prometa que se casará con él. Todos sus pequeños amigos acuden a rescatarla y Papá Pitufo consigue ponerle los zapatos mágicos al duende, obligándole a bailar hasta que se hace de noche.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Fortachón descubre a un caballero que lo ayuda a combatir a un Dragón, pero éste huye y deja a Fortachón defendiendo a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tontín y Pitufina son capturados para ser exhibidos en una Feria. Papá Pitufo aprovecha la torpeza de Gargamel para rescatarlos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Poeta y Pintor se sienten poco valorados y huyen a una isla tormentosa sin saber que Gargamel los sigue hasta allí.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un malvado brujo captura a los Pitufos para usarlos en su plan para robar todo el oro del Rey Argón.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Palomo no puede decir que no y eso provoca que todos le encarguen sus tareas. Pronto eso lo llevará a enfrentar un gran peligro.

programme.title: No Puedo Pitufar La Música
programme.desc: No hay nada que la hechicera Clorhidris odie tanto como el amor en el mundo. Le gustaría que el amor desapareciera de la faz de la tierra y, para conseguirlo, ha decidido comenzar por la música. Lanza un hechizo a un cuerno mágico que absorberá la melodía de las canciones… en especial, de las canciones de los Pitufos. Con la ayuda de su amiga Laconia, es posible que los Pitufos consigan echar por tierra el malvado plan de Clorhidris…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido unos huevos mágicos de cristal citoplásmico que le permitirán intercambiar su cuerpo con el de Papá Pitufo. ¿Qué otro plan mejor que ese podría haber? Una vez que esté en el cuerpo de Papá Pitufo, llevará a todos los Pitufos hasta su caldero. Pero, por juegos del destino, Gargamel se transforma en Perro, el perro de los Pitufos…

programme.title: El Genio De Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta qué hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando debería estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hará que, más que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: No todos los días se encuentra uno con una flor parlante. Y, en especial, con un personaje como Petaluma, una planta bulbosa algo arrogante con la que Pitufina se encuentra en el bosque. Por supuesto, Pitufina se muestra encantada y lleva a Petaluma con ella a la Aldea Pitufa… desencadenando un proceso que pondrá en peligro a todos los Pitufos. Parece que las flores están hechas para contemplarlas y no para escucharlas.
